title: sub: p1-tool-runtime
creator: codex
notes: S1 done (PR #591). S2 done (PR #592). S3a done (PR #593, direct sites 9->7). S3b done (PR #594, 7->6). S3c-1 done (PR #595, 6->5). S3c-2 done (PR #596, 5->3, domain-outcome channel). S3d (this branch): migrates trend_scout's three xhs platform reads (xhs.trending / xhs.keyword_monitor / xhs.competitor_analyzer), so direct sites go 3->0 and the agent layer no longer imports backend.tools at all. Degradation semantics are unchanged (data_source stays llm_generated on failure); what changed is that the failure is now visible: both the tool and the agent used to swallow it, leaving the Gateway recording a successful empty read. The three tools no longer catch their own exceptions (normalisation has one home, the Gateway), and they check the new XHSClient.can_read before calling - without it monitor_keywords fabricates one row of zeros per keyword and trend_scout reported that as data_source=real. Catalogue: xhs.* reads declare no retry (the call sites never retried; the dominant failure is a missing credential) and keep auth_scope=('xhs:read',) as a declaration only (enforcement is P2a). Remaining residues: XHSClient's own []-on-failure contract at layer 1, and the niche-passed-as-account_id payload shape. Next: S4 (L1 tool schema producer), S5 (AST gate + docs).
